concerns.text: The plan cites 'MODIS_multiclass_dataset.csv' from a 'lake-powell-toy-dataset' repository as the primary source for continental-scale MODIS LST/NDVI data. This dataset is explicitly a localized toy sample (Lake Powell) and lacks the spatiotemporal coverage (North America, 2015-2023) required to train a model for continental migration patterns. Using this dataset renders the core hypothesis (FR-004, FR-007) untestable as written, as the model cannot learn continental gradients from a single lake's data.

The fallback MODIS URLs also point to 'lake-powell-toy-dataset' repositories. The plan acknowledges this gap ('Critical Data Gap Note') but proposes a strategy of 'methodological validation' on toy data while claiming to produce 'continental-scale maps' (FR-007). This is a fundamental mismatch: the cited resources cannot support the required output. The plan must identify a verified, continental-scale MODIS source (e.g., NASA Earthdata via a verified proxy) or scope the project to the Lake Powell region only.
